notes: Case 1 (SHELLING OUT TO SQLITE3 WITH INLINE SQL QUERY) shells to sqlite3.exe via 'x cmd /K sqlite3 ...' host commands to create table tst(val real), insert (100),(200),(300),(400), then create table x2 as select val, cast(2*val as real) as x2 from tst. No sqlite3 binary or CMD.EXE is available on a hosted engine, so this bundle keeps the author's table/column names and literal data and reproduces the same create+insert+derive-x2 logic natively via DATA step + PROC SQL instead of the shell-out.
